1.english_reference: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honour in abundance

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֧י לִֽ יהוֹשָׁפָ֛ט עֹ֥שֶׁר וְ כָב֖וֹד לָ רֹ֑ב
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγενήθη τῷ Ἰωσαφὰτ ἔτι πλοῦτος καὶ δόξα πολλή ,
traditions.VUL: Fuit ergo Iósaphat dives et ínclytus multum ,
traditions.KJV: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honour in abundance ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתְחַתֵּ֖ן לְ אַחְאָֽב
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπεγαμβρεύσατο ἐν οἴκῳ Ἀχαάβ .
traditions.VUL: et affinitáte coniúnctus est Achab .
traditions.KJV: and joined affinity with Ahab .

2.english_reference: And after [ certain ] years he went down to Ahab to Samaria

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּרֶד֩ לְ קֵ֨ץ שָׁנִ֤ים אֶל אַחְאָב֙ לְ שֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατέβη διὰ τέλους ἐτῶν πρὸς Ἀχαὰβ εἰς Σαμάρειαν ,
traditions.VUL: Descendítque post annos ad eum in Samaríam :
traditions.KJV: And after [ certain ] years he went down to Ahab to Samaria .

2.english_reference: And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance , and for the people that [ he had ] with him

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּֽזְבַּֽח ל֨ וֹ אַחְאָ֜ב צֹ֤אן וּ בָקָר֙ לָ רֹ֔ב וְ לָ עָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִמּ֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔθυσεν αὐτῷ Ἀχαὰβ πρόβατα καὶ μόσχους πολλοὺς καὶ τῷ λαῷ τῷ μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: ad cuius advéntum mactávit Achab aríetes , et boves plúrimos , ipsi , et pópulo qui vénerat cum eo :
traditions.KJV: And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance , and for the people that [ he had ] with him ,

2.english_reference: and persuaded him to go up [ with him ] to Ramothgilead

traditions.WLC: וַ יְסִיתֵ֕ הוּ לַ עֲל֖וֹת אֶל רָמ֥וֹת גִּלְעָֽד
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἠγάπα αὐτὸν τοῦ συναναβῆναι μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ εἰς Ῥαμὼθ τῆς Γαλααδείτιδος .
traditions.VUL: persuasítque illi ut ascénderet in Ramoth Gálaad .
traditions.KJV: and persuaded him to go up [ with him ] to Ramothgilead .

3.english_reference: And Ahab king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat king of Judah , Wilt thou go with me to Ramothgilead ?

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֜אמֶר אַחְאָ֣ב מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶל יְהֽוֹשָׁפָט֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה הֲ תֵלֵ֥ךְ עִמִּ֖ י רָמֹ֣ת גִּלְעָ֑ד
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Ἀχαὰβ βασιλεὺς Ἰσραὴλ πρὸς Ἰωσαφὰτ βασιλέα Ἰούδα Πορεύσῃ μετ᾽ ἐμοῦ εἰς Ῥαμὼθ τῆς Γαλααδείτιδος ;
traditions.VUL: Dixítque Achab rex Israel ad Iósaphat regem Iuda : Veni mecum in Ramoth Gálaad .
traditions.KJV: And Ahab king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat king of Judah , Wilt thou go with me to Ramothgilead ?

3.english_reference: And he answered him , I [ am ] as thou [ art ] , and my people as thy people

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗ וֹ כָּמ֤וֹ נִי כָמ֨וֹ ךָ֙ וּ כְ עַמְּ ךָ֣ עַמִּ֔ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ὡς ἐγώ , οὕτως καὶ σύ · ὡς ὁ λαός μου , καὶ ὁ λαός σου
traditions.VUL: Cui ille respóndit : Ut ego , et tu : sicut pópulus tuus , sic et pópulus meus :
traditions.KJV: And he answered him , I [ am ] as thou [ art ] , and my people as thy people ;

3.english_reference: and [ we will be ] with thee in the war

traditions.WLC: וְ עִמְּ ךָ֖ בַּ מִּלְחָמָֽה
traditions.LXX: μετὰ σου εἰς πόλεμον .
traditions.VUL: tecúmque érimus in bello .
traditions.KJV: and [ we will be ] with thee in the war .

4.english_reference: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel , Inquire , I pray thee , at the word of the LORD to day

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט אֶל מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל דְּרָשׁ נָ֥א כַ יּ֖וֹם אֶת דְּבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Ἰωσαφὰτ πρὸς βασιλέα Ἰσραήλ Ζήτησον δὴ σήμερον τὸν κύριον .
traditions.VUL: Dixítque Iósaphat ad regem Israel : Cónsule óbsecro impræsentiárum sermónem Dómini .
traditions.KJV: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel , Inquire , I pray thee , at the word of the LORD to day .

5.english_reference: Therefore the king of Israel gathered together of prophets four hundred men

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקְבֹּ֨ץ מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אֶֽת הַ נְּבִאִים֮ אַרְבַּ֣ע מֵא֣וֹת אִישׁ֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ συνήγαγεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ἰσραὴλ τοὺς προφήτας τετρακοσίους ἄνδρας
traditions.VUL: Congregávit ígitur rex Israel prophetárum quadringéntos viros ,
traditions.KJV: Therefore the king of Israel gathered together of prophets four hundred men ,

5.english_reference: and said unto them , Shall we go to Ramothgilead to battle , or shall I forbear ?

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ הֶ֗ם הֲ נֵלֵ֞ךְ אֶל רָמֹ֥ת גִּלְעָ֛ד לַ מִּלְחָמָ֖ה אִם אֶחְדָּ֑ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Εἰ πορευθῶ εἰς Ῥαμὼθ Γαλαὰδ εἰς πόλεμον ἢ ἐπίσχω ;
traditions.VUL: et dixit ad eos : In Ramoth Gálaad ad bellándum ire debémus , an quiéscere ?
traditions.KJV: and said unto them , Shall we go to Ramothgilead to battle , or shall I forbear ?

5.english_reference: And they said , Go up ; for God will deliver [ it ] into the king ’s hand

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּאמְר֣וּ עֲלֵ֔ה וְ יִתֵּ֥ן הָ אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּ יַ֥ד הַ מֶּֽלֶךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπαν Ἀνάβαινε , καὶ δώσει ὁ θεὸς εἰς τὰς χεῖρας τοῦ βασιλέως .
traditions.VUL: At illi : Ascénde , ínquiunt , et tradet Deus in manu regis .
traditions.KJV: And they said , Go up ; for God will deliver [ it ] into the king ’s hand .

6.english_reference: But Jehoshaphat said , [ Is there ] not here a prophet of the LORD besides , that we might inquire of him ?

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ יְה֣וֹשָׁפָ֔ט הַ אֵ֨ין פֹּ֥ה נָבִ֛יא לַ יהוָ֖ה ע֑וֹד וְ נִדְרְשָׁ֖ה מֵ אֹתֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Ἰωσαφάτ Οὐκ ἔστιν ὧδε προφήτης τοῦ κυρίου ἔτι καὶ ἐπιζητήσομεν παρ᾽ αὐτοῦ ;
traditions.VUL: Dixítque Iósaphat : Numquid non est hic prophétes Dómini , ut ab illo étiam requirámus ?
traditions.KJV: But Jehoshaphat said , [ Is there ] not here a prophet of the LORD besides , that we might inquire of him ?

7.english_reference: [ There is ] yet one man , by whom we may inquire of the LORD

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל אֶֽל יְהוֹשָׁפָ֡ט ע֣וֹד אִישׁ אֶחָ֡ד לִ דְרוֹשׁ֩ אֶת יְהוָ֨ה מֵֽ אֹת֜ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν βασιλεὺς Ἰσραὴλ πρὸς Ἰωσαφάτ Ἔτι ἀνὴρ εἷς τοῦ ζητῆσαι τὸν κύριον δι᾽ αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Et ait rex Israel ad Iósaphat : Est vir unus a quo póssumus quǽrere Dómini voluntátem :
traditions.KJV: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , [ There is ] yet one man , by whom we may inquire of the LORD :

7.english_reference: but I hate him ; for he never prophesied good unto me , but always evil

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲנִ֣י שְׂנֵאתִ֗י הוּ כִּֽי אֵ֠ינֶ נּוּ מִתְנַבֵּ֨א עָלַ֤ י לְ טוֹבָה֙ כִּ֣י כָל יָמָ֣י ו לְ רָעָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγὼ ἐμίσησα αὐτόν , ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν προφητεύων περί ἐμοῦ εἰς ἀγαθά , ὅτι πᾶσαι αἱ ἡμέραι αὐτοῦ εἰς κακά ,
traditions.VUL: sed ego odi eum , quia non prophétat mihi bonum , sed malum omni témpore :
traditions.KJV: but I hate him ; for he never prophesied good unto me , but always evil :

7.english_reference: the same [ is ] Micaiah the son of Imla

traditions.WLC: ה֖וּא מִיכָ֣יְהוּ בֶן יִמְלָ֑א
traditions.LXX: οὗτος Μειχαίας υἱὸς Ἰεμαάς .
traditions.VUL: est autem Michǽas fílius Iemla .
traditions.KJV: the same [ is ] Micaiah the son of Imla .

7.english_reference: And Jehoshaphat said , Let not the king say so

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ יְה֣וֹשָׁפָ֔ט אַל יֹאמַ֥ר הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ כֵּֽן
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Ἰωσαφάτ Μὴ λαλείτω ὁ βασιλεὺς οὕτως .
traditions.VUL: Dixítque Iósaphat : Ne loquáris rex hoc modo .
traditions.KJV: And Jehoshaphat said , Let not the king say so .

8.english_reference: And the king of Israel called for one [ of his ] officers

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקְרָא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל סָרִ֖יס אֶחָ֑ד
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν ὁ βασιλεὺς εὐνοῦχον ἕνα
traditions.VUL: Vocávit ergo rex Israel unum de eunúchis ,
traditions.KJV: And the king of Israel called for one [ of his ] officers ,

8.english_reference: and said , Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imla

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֕אמֶר מַהֵ֖ר מיכהו בֶן יִמְלָֽא
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Τάχος Μειχαίαν υἱὸν Ἰεμαά .
traditions.VUL: et dixit ei : Voca cito Michǽam fílium Iemla .
traditions.KJV: and said , Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imla .

9.english_reference: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah sat either of them on his throne , clothed in [ their ] robes

traditions.WLC: וּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל וִֽ יהוֹשָׁפָ֣ט מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֡ה יוֹשְׁבִים֩ אִ֨ישׁ עַל כִּסְא֜ וֹ מְלֻבָּשִׁ֤ים בְּגָדִים֙
traditions.LXX: καὶ βασιλεὺς Ἰσραὴλ καὶ Ἰωσαφὰτ βασιλεὺς Ἰούδα καθήμενοι ἕκαστος ἐπὶ θρόνου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐνδεδυμένοι στολάς ,
traditions.VUL: Porro rex Israel , et Iósaphat rex Iuda , utérque sedébant in sólio suo , vestíti cultu régio :
traditions.KJV: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah sat either of them on his throne , clothed in [ their ] robes ,

9.english_reference: and they sat in a void place at the entering in of the gate of Samaria

traditions.WLC: וְ יֹשְׁבִ֣ים בְּ גֹ֔רֶן פֶּ֖תַח שַׁ֣עַר שֹׁמְר֑וֹן
traditions.LXX: καθήμενοι ἐν τῷ εὐρυχώρῳ θύρας πύλης Σαμαρείας ,
traditions.VUL: sedébant autem in área iuxta portam Samaríæ ,
traditions.KJV: and they sat in a void place at the entering in of the gate of Samaria ;

9.english_reference: and all the prophets prophesied before them

traditions.WLC: וְ כָל הַ֨ נְּבִיאִ֔ים מִֽתְנַבְּאִ֖ים לִ פְנֵי הֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ πάντες οἱ προφῆται ἐπροφήτευον ἐναντίον αὐτῶν .
traditions.VUL: omnésque prophétæ vaticinabántur coram eis .
traditions.KJV: and all the prophets prophesied before them .

10.english_reference: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah had made him horns of iron

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֥עַשׂ ל֛ וֹ צִדְקִיָּ֥הוּ בֶֽן כְּנַעֲנָ֖ה קַרְנֵ֣י בַרְזֶ֑ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν ἑαυτῷ Σεδεκίας υἱὸς Χανάαν κέρατα σιδηρᾶ
traditions.VUL: Sedecías vero fílius Chanáana fecit sibi córnua férrea ,
traditions.KJV: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah had made him horns of iron ,

10.english_reference: and said , Thus saith the LORD , With these thou shalt push Syria until they be consumed

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה בְּ אֵ֛לֶּה תְּנַגַּ֥ח אֶת אֲרָ֖ם עַד כַּלּוֹתָֽ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Τάδε λέγει Κύριος Ἐν τούτοις κερατιεῖς τὴν Συρίαν ἕως ἂν συντελεσθῇ .
traditions.VUL: et ait : Hæc dicit Dóminus : His ventilábis Sýriam , donec cónteras eam .
traditions.KJV: and said , Thus saith the LORD , With these thou shalt push Syria until they be consumed .

11.english_reference: And all the prophets prophesied so

traditions.WLC: וְ כָל הַ֨ נְּבִאִ֔ים נִבְּאִ֥ים כֵּ֖ן
traditions.LXX: καὶ πάντες οἱ προφῆται ἐπροφήτευον οὕτως
traditions.VUL: Omnésque prophétæ simíliter prophetábant ,
traditions.KJV: And all the prophets prophesied so ,

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹ֑ר
traditions.LXX: λέγοντες
traditions.VUL: atque dicébant :
traditions.KJV: saying ,

11.english_reference: Go up to Ramothgilead, and prosper

traditions.WLC: עֲלֵ֞ה רָמֹ֤ת גִּלְעָד֙ וְ הַצְלַ֔ח
traditions.LXX: Ἀνάβαινε εἰς Ῥαμὼθ Γαλαάδ , καὶ εὐοδωθήσῃ ,
traditions.VUL: Ascénde in Ramoth Gálaad , et prosperáberis ,
traditions.KJV: Go up to Ramothgilead , and prosper :

11.english_reference: for the LORD shall deliver [ it ] into the hand of the king

traditions.WLC: וְ נָתַ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה בְּ יַ֥ד הַ מֶּֽלֶךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ δώσει Κύριος εἰς χεῖρας τοῦ βασιλέως .
traditions.VUL: et tradet eos Dóminus in manu regis .
traditions.KJV: for the LORD shall deliver [ it ] into the hand of the king .

12.english_reference: And the messenger that went to call Micaiah spake to him, saying

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ מַּלְאָ֞ךְ אֲשֶׁר הָלַ֣ךְ לִ קְרֹ֣א לְ מִיכָ֗יְהוּ דִּבֶּ֤ר אֵלָי ו֙ לֵ אמֹ֔ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὁ ἄγγελος ὁ πορευθεὶς τοῦ καλέσαι τὸν Μειχαίαν ἐλάλησεν αὐτῷ λέγων
traditions.VUL: Núntius autem , qui íerat ad vocándum Michǽam , ait illi :
traditions.KJV: And the messenger that went to call Micaiah spake to him , saying ,

12.english_reference: Behold, the words of the prophets [ declare ] good to the king with one assent

traditions.WLC: הִנֵּ֞ה דִּבְרֵ֧י הַ נְּבִאִ֛ים פֶּֽה אֶחָ֥ד ט֖וֹב אֶל הַ מֶּ֑לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: Ἰδοὺ ἐλάλησαν οἱ προφῆται ἐν στόματι ἑνὶ ἀγαθὰ περὶ τοῦ βασιλέως ,
traditions.VUL: En verba ómnium prophetárum uno ore bona regi annúntiant :
traditions.KJV: Behold , the words of the prophets [ declare ] good to the king with one assent ;

12.english_reference: let thy word therefore, I pray thee, be like one of theirs

traditions.WLC: וִֽ יהִי נָ֧א דְבָרְ ךָ֛ כְּ אַחַ֥ד מֵ הֶ֖ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔστωσαν δὴ οἱ λόγοι σου ὡς ἑνὸς αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: quæso ergo te ut et sermo tuus ab eis non disséntiat ,
traditions.KJV: let thy word therefore , I pray thee , be like one of theirs ,

traditions.WLC: וְ דִבַּ֥רְתָּ טּֽוֹב
traditions.LXX: καὶ λαλήσεις ἀγαθά .
traditions.VUL: loquarísque próspera .
traditions.KJV: and speak thou good .

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֖אמֶר מִיכָ֑יְהוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Μειχαίας
traditions.VUL: Cui respóndit Michǽas :
traditions.KJV: And Micaiah said , [ As ]

traditions.WLC: חַי יְהוָ֕ה
traditions.LXX: Ζῇ Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Vivit Dóminus ,
traditions.KJV: the LORD liveth ,

13.english_reference: even what my God saith, that will I speak

traditions.WLC: כִּ֛י אֶת אֲשֶׁר יֹאמַ֥ר אֱלֹהַ֖ י אֹת֥ וֹ אֲדַבֵּֽר
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ὃ ἐὰν εἴπῃ ὁ θεὸς πρὸς μέ , αὐτὸ λαλήσω .
traditions.VUL: quia quodcúmque díxerit mihi Deus meus , hoc loquar .
traditions.KJV: even what my God saith , that will I speak .

14.english_reference: And when he was come to the king

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹא֮ אֶל הַ מֶּלֶךְ֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦλθεν πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα ·
traditions.VUL: Venit ergo ad regem .
traditions.KJV: And when he was come to the king ,

14.english_reference: the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go to Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear ?

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר הַ מֶּ֜לֶךְ אֵלָ֗י ו מִיכָה֙ הֲ נֵלֵ֞ךְ אֶל רָמֹ֥ת גִּלְעָ֛ד לַ מִּלְחָמָ֖ה אִם אֶחְדָּ֑ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ βασιλεύς Μειχαία , εἰ πορευθῶ εἰς Ῥαμὼθ Γαλαὰδ εἰς πόλεμον ἢ ἐπίσχω ;
traditions.VUL: Cui rex ait : Michǽa , ire debémus in Ramoth Gálaad ad bellándum , an quiéscere ?
